mechanism: Both drugs inhibit monoamine reuptake (rizatriptan via serotonin agonism, valbenazine via VMAT2 inhibition leading to increased monoamine availability), creating potential for additive serotonergic effects and increased CNS depression.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); use combination cautiously and educate patients on warning signs; consider alternative triptan if serotonergic effects emerge.
